inputs.target_skill_path: Required target skill path or repository path.
inputs.goal: Required deterministic skill creation or upgrade goal.
inputs.channel: Required package channel: released or beta.
inputs.language: Optional language surface for package and guide links: en or zh-cn. If omitted, the current public guide surface defaults to en, so callers should pass zh-cn explicitly when they need Chinese guide links and should pass --lang <language> when invoking the guide command.
inputs.context_file: Optional path to a JSON context file.

default_assumptions.package_index_source: The source of truth for acquiring the SO package is the absolute URL of the released or beta package index page that matches the chosen language surface. A local runtime install path is only an execution detail when the agent needs to run so.dll, and that runtime must follow the selected package channel unless the capability is explicitly marked Beta Only.
default_assumptions.target_product_rule: Any SO skill or target product that adopts Loom-bin-based skills must preserve released and beta package index absolute URLs in its own skill or product-facing docs, using localized mirrors when the product exposes localized package index pages.
default_assumptions.runtime_install_root: If execution needs a local runtime, resolve the exact package version from NuGet first and freshly download it unless the local cache already holds that exact version, then install or unpack the runtime from the selected package channel into an external temporary directory outside the target repository. Use GitHub-hosted package assets only as fallback when NuGet.org is unavailable.
default_assumptions.runtime_bundle_restore: When SO execution or target-skill restoration needs local NuGet acquisition, restore the SO runtime bundle instead of only the SO package: Techne.Loom.SkillOrchestrator, Techne.Loom.Common, and Techne.Loom.Abstractions, all at the same resolved channel/version.
default_assumptions.executor: The AI agent executes dotnet so.dll compile/run/resume/status/inspect-workflow/inspect-events directly in the terminal.
default_assumptions.dll_interface_mapping: Use only the public SO CLI surface from the selected channel guide, and verify dotnet so.dll parameter --help first (invoked as dotnet so.dll --help): dotnet so.dll --guide [--lang <language>], compile, run, resume, status, inspect-workflow, and inspect-events.
default_assumptions.workflow_description_granularity: Fine-grained, derived from the current SKILL.md decision tree when it exists, or from goal plus supporting references when creating a greenfield skill, and then reviewed by the maintainer.
default_assumptions.context_merge: When references Markdown sources exist, concatenate references/*.md into a temporary merged-context.md working note with clear section headers, then convert the needed content into a temporary JSON context file for SO run context input.
default_assumptions.template_and_audit_layout: Store the workflow template JSON separately. Unless the user explicitly chooses an audit destination, keep event_log, Mermaid, HTML, and workflow backups under a user-level temporary audit root instead of the target skill directory.
default_assumptions.locked_runtime_version: After enhancement, write a machine-readable package lock file with the exact resolved SO NuGet version, channel, package identity, and runtime bundle members. When the enhanced target skill runs later, restore that exact locked SO runtime bundle from NuGet first, freshly downloading it unless the local cache already holds that exact version bundle.
default_assumptions.target_skill_lock_reference: The enhanced target SKILL.md must explicitly reference <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json as the authoritative SO runtime version lock and must state that routine SO runtime restoration resolves the exact locked runtime bundle from NuGet first, freshly downloading it unless the local cache already holds that exact version bundle.
default_assumptions.reenhancement_upgrade_policy: When the target skill needs another enhancement pass, ignore the old lock for upgrade selection and reacquire the latest version from the user-chosen released or beta channel, then rewrite the package lock file.
default_assumptions.template_validation_gate: Before the generated workflow template can become the execution authority for the enhanced target skill, it must be reviewed against the selected channel guide for completeness and detail, and it must also pass dotnet so.dll compile --workflow-file <path>.
default_assumptions.template_authority: The reviewed workflow template JSON is the execution authority for the enhanced target skill after dotnet so.dll compile succeeds.
default_assumptions.skill_markdown_shape: Compress the enhanced SKILL.md to about 80-100 lines while preserving high-level steps, guardrail headings, SO guidance, and the ## Workflow Contract title.
default_assumptions.released_channel_wording: If released artifacts do not provide the same SO enhancement surface, label that capability Beta Only.
default_assumptions.weave_out_policy: Use structured blocked payload fields such as current_step_kind to classify WaitResume handling, and consume skill_hint literally as the next external action instruction. Ask the user only when the structured payload indicates mandatory human-input seams. For waits on email, files, messages, or downstream script results, treat the state as a valid external wait that either returns the expected next input shape to the user or pauses until the external result arrives. Continue automatically only when the structured payload plus literal skill_hint point to a non-human continuation.
default_assumptions.skill_layer_scope: These defaults are skill-layer adaptation defaults rather than generic SO runtime guarantees. If the selected channel guide does not expose an equivalent surface, mark that behavior as Beta Only.

outputs.package_index_link: Absolute URL to the released or beta package index page that matches the chosen language surface.
outputs.package_index_links: Released/beta package index absolute URL set, including localized mirrors when they exist.
outputs.dll_interface_mapping: Confirmed mapping between the skill runtime flow and SO public CLI commands used by the selected channel guide, including a recorded dotnet so.dll parameter --help verification step.
outputs.package_lock_template_example: Path to the standard SO package lock template example that enhanced target skills should follow.
outputs.package_lock_file: Machine-readable SO package lock file path with package identity, chosen channel, exact resolved version used for the enhancement pass, and runtime bundle members.
outputs.runtime_bundle_packages: SO runtime bundle package list used for enhancement-time and target-skill restoration: Techne.Loom.SkillOrchestrator, Techne.Loom.Common, and Techne.Loom.Abstractions.
outputs.target_skill_lock_reference: Explicit checked-in SKILL.md reference to <target-skill-root>/assets/so-workflow/so-package-lock.json as the authoritative SO runtime version lock.
outputs.workflow_template: Deterministic workflow JSON template path. This template only becomes the execution authority for the enhanced target skill after guide-alignment review plus dotnet so.dll compile succeed.
outputs.audit_artifacts: Mermaid Markdown, HTML, and workflow JSON backup links.
